raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

`/v1/audio/transcriptions` returns HTTP 500 on every request for Qwen3-Omni and Gemma 4, so ASR evals through the endpoint score WER 100. The endpoint sends `text=""`, which reaches the multimodal processor as an empty `input_ids` list. Neither processor builds a prompt for a text-less audio request, so `load_mm_data` asserts:

- Qwen3-Omni: `assert isinstance(prompt, str)`
- Gemma 4: `assert len(prompt) and isinstance(prompt[0], int)`

Neither model has a transcription adapter either. `resolve_adapter` would fall back to `WhisperAdapter`, which adds Whisper-only sampling keys that only the Whisper processor removes.

The open ASR PRs #44452 (AudioFlamingo3, generic adapter) and #44473 (Voxtral, MiDashengLM) don't cover these models, and this PR doesn't depend on them.

## Modifications

**Qwen3-Omni**
- `QwenVLImageProcessor._build_omni_transcription_prompt`: for a `qwen3_omni_moe` audio request with no text, render the model card's evaluation prompt through the chat template. The audio comes first, then "Transcribe the \<Language\> audio into text.", with no system turn. For `zh` it uses the card's Chinese prompt; with no language it drops the language name. Caller text or `input_ids` pass through unchanged.
- `Qwen3OmniAdapter` (key `Qwen3OmniMoe`): duration-scaled `max_new_tokens` like the other speech-LM adapters. It forwards `request.language` in `sampling_params` and reports it in `verbose_json`.
- `BaseMultimodalProcessor._pop_transcription_language`: removes that key before `SamplingParams` sees it, the same way the Whisper processor handles its transcription keys.

**Gemma 4**
- `Gemma4SGLangProcessor`: for audio with no text, build the model card's ASR chat prompt, instruction before audio. In an A/B, audio first raised LibriSpeech test-other WER from ~14 to 23–37.
- `Gemma4Adapter` (key `Gemma4`, matches `Gemma4ForConditionalGeneration` and `Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration`):
  - duration-scaled `max_new_tokens`;
  - a 30 s clip limit, the model's audio maximum, so longer clips are split;
  - a `logit_bias` ban on `<|channel>` (id 100). With thinking off, the template already ends in an empty thought block. Under greedy decoding the model still reopens one on 2–5 % of clips and repeats it until `max_new_tokens`; HF transformers does the same on those clips. On 200 clips the ban takes loops from 10 to 0 and WER from 22.1 to 7.6.
- Cookbook: the Gemma 4 page documents the endpoint.

**Tests**
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_transcription_adapters.py` covers:
  - adapter resolution for Qwen3-Omni and both Gemma 4 architectures;
  - sampling params, including language forwarding and the `<|channel>` ban;
  - the 30 s clip cap.
- New `test/registered/unit/multimodal/test_qwen3_omni_transcription_prompt.py` covers:
  - prompt text and audio/text order;
  - the `zh` and no-language cases;
  - pass-through of caller text and `input_ids`;
  - `language` being removed from `sampling_params`.

## Accuracy Tests

The harness is lmms-eval `sglang_asr`, which posts each clip to `/v1/audio/transcriptions`. I used it because sgl-eval ships no ASR task. Runs were on the full `openslr_librispeech_other` split (2939 clips), greedy, seed 42, on Intel Arc Pro B70 with `--attention-backend intel_xpu`. The image was `intel/sglang-dev:latest` `dbe08e9f1e24` (main@7fe5b127e4) with this branch on `PYTHONPATH`.

| Model | Before (stock) | After | Reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct | WER 100 (20/20 HTTP 500) | **2.41** | 2.48 (Qwen3-Omni tech report) |
| google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w4a16-ct | WER 100 (100/100 HTTP 500) | **6.42** | — |

The stock runs used 20/100-clip subsets because every request fails. After the fix, all 2939 requests returned HTTP 200, with no empty predictions and no server tracebacks. Only the Gemma 4 12B QAT checkpoint was measured; E2B/E4B resolve to the same adapter but were not run.

```bash
# Qwen3-Omni: 2x B70 (64 GB) can't hold the ~63.5 GB bf16 thinker, so tp2 + weight offload (same bf16 math)
SGLANG_USE_SGL_XPU=1 sglang serve --model-path Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct --device xpu \
  --tp-size 2 --mem-fraction-static 0.85 --trust-remote-code --enable-multimodal \
  --cpu-offload-gb 10 --attention-backend intel_xpu

# Gemma 4
SGLANG_USE_SGL_XPU=1 sglang serve --model-path google/gemma-4-12B-it-qat-w4a16-ct --device xpu \
  --tp-size 1 --mem-fraction-static 0.6 --trust-remote-code --enable-multimodal \
  --json-model-override-args '{"audio_config":{"output_proj_dims":640}}' \
  --reasoning-parser gemma4 --tool-call-parser gemma4 \
  --mm-process-config '{"image":{"max_soft_tokens":560}}' --attention-backend intel_xpu

# Client (num_concurrent/batch_size: 8 for Qwen3-Omni, 16 for Gemma 4)
python -m lmms_eval --model sglang_asr \
  --model_args pretrained=<model>,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:30000/v1,num_concurrent=16 \
  --tasks openslr_librispeech_other --batch_size 16 --seed 42
```

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. The change is prompt construction and sampling parameters only; kernel and model forward code are untouched.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

 For speech translation (AST), ask for the transcription in the source language first, then the translation: *"Transcribe the following speech segment in {SOURCE_LANGUAGE}, then translate it into {TARGET_LANGUAGE}. ..."*
 
+For plain transcription you can also use the OpenAI-compatible `/v1/audio/transcriptions` endpoint. The server builds the model card's language-agnostic transcription prompt ("Transcribe the following speech segment in its original language. ..."), splits clips longer than the 30-second audio limit, and keeps the model from emitting empty thought-channel blocks, which it otherwise sometimes repeats instead of transcribing under greedy decoding:
+
+```bash Command
+curl http://localhost:30000/v1/audio/transcriptions \
+  -F file=@sample.wav -F model=google/gemma-4-12B-it -F response_format=json
+```
+

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Optional
+
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.protocol import (
+    TranscriptionRequest,
+    TranscriptionUsage,
+    TranscriptionVerboseResponse,
+)
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.transcription_adapters.base import (
+    TranscriptionAdapter,
+    register_transcription_adapter,
+)
+
+# Per-second output-token budget for clips long enough to exceed the floor.
+# Speech runs ~2-3 words/s and tokenizers emit >1 token/word, so 15 tok/s
+# leaves generous headroom over the natural transcript length while still
+# bounding runaway generation.
+_MAX_NEW_TOKENS_PER_SECOND = 15
+# Floor for the generation-length cap; sized so a ~30s clip always fits.
+_DEFAULT_MAX_NEW_TOKENS = 448
+
+# ``<|channel>`` in the tokenizer shared by every Gemma 4 model.
+_CHANNEL_OPEN_TOKEN_ID = 100
+
+
+@register_transcription_adapter("Gemma4")
+class Gemma4Adapter(TranscriptionAdapter):
+    """Transcription adapter for the audio-capable Gemma 4 models (E2B, E4B, 12B).
+
+    Gemma 4 is a decoder-only multimodal LM: ``Gemma4SGLangProcessor`` builds the
+    model card's ASR chat prompt for text-less requests and the model free-form
+    generates the transcript, so there is no Whisper-style language/task prefix.
+
+    With thinking disabled the chat template already ends in an empty
+    ``<|channel>thought\\n<channel|>`` block, yet under greedy decoding the model
+    sometimes opens more of them, and on some clips repeats the empty block until
+    ``max_new_tokens`` instead of transcribing (the HF reference does the same).
+    A transcription never needs a thought channel, so ``<|channel>`` is banned.
+    """
+
+    def build_sampling_params(self, request: TranscriptionRequest) -> dict:
+        # ``/v1/audio/transcriptions`` has no request-side length field, so the
+        # adapter is the only control. Short clips use the floor; longer clips
+        # scale with duration so the transcript is not silently truncated.
+        duration_s = request.audio_duration_s or 0.0
+        return {
+            "temperature": request.temperature,
+            "max_new_tokens": max(
+                _DEFAULT_MAX_NEW_TOKENS,
+                int(duration_s * _MAX_NEW_TOKENS_PER_SECOND),
+            ),
+            "logit_bias": {str(_CHANNEL_OPEN_TOKEN_ID): -100.0},
+        }
+
+    @property
+    def max_audio_clip_s(self) -> Optional[float]:
+        # Gemma 4 audio input supports at most 30 seconds (model card).
+        return 30.0
+
+    def build_verbose_response(
+        self,
+        request: TranscriptionRequest,
+        text: str,
+        ret: dict,
+        tokenizer,
+        usage: TranscriptionUsage,
+    ) -> TranscriptionVerboseResponse:
+        # ``language`` left unset: the model infers the language from the audio.
+        return TranscriptionVerboseResponse(
+            language=None,
+            duration=round(request.audio_duration_s, 2),
+            text=text,
+            segments=[],
+            usage=usage,
+        )

+"""Unit tests for the default ASR prompt the Qwen3-Omni processor builds for
+``/v1/audio/transcriptions`` requests, which arrive with empty text, and for
+the helper that pops the adapter-forwarded language out of ``sampling_params``.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import MagicMock
+
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.base_processor import BaseMultimodalProcessor
+from sglang.srt.multimodal.processors.qwen_vl import QwenVLImageProcessor
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+def _chat_processor():
+    """A processor stub whose chat template returns the conversation itself."""
+    processor = MagicMock()
+    processor.apply_chat_template.side_effect = lambda conversation, **_: conversation
+    return processor
+
+
+def _user_text(conversation):
+    (message,) = conversation
+    return [part for part in message["content"] if part["type"] == "text"][0]["text"]
+
+
+class TestPopTranscriptionLanguage(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_pops_language_so_sampling_params_stays_valid(self):
+        request = SimpleNamespace(
+            sampling_params={"language": "en", "max_new_tokens": 8}
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            BaseMultimodalProcessor._pop_transcription_language(request), "en"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(request.sampling_params, {"max_new_tokens": 8})
+
+    def test_missing_language_or_params(self):
+        pop = BaseMultimodalProcessor._pop_transcription_language
+        self.assertIsNone(pop(SimpleNamespace(sampling_params={})))
+        self.assertIsNone(pop(SimpleNamespace(sampling_params=None)))
+        self.assertIsNone(pop(None))
+
+
+class TestQwen3OmniTranscriptionPrompt(CustomTestCase):
+    def setUp(self):
+        self.processor = object.__new__(QwenVLImageProcessor)
+        self.processor._processor = _chat_processor()
+
+    def _prompt(self, input_text, language):
+        request = SimpleNamespace(sampling_params={"language": language})
+        prompt = self.processor._build_omni_transcription_prompt(input_text, request)
+        self.assertNotIn("language", request.sampling_params)
+        return prompt
+
+    def test_empty_text_uses_model_card_prompt(self):
+        conversation = self._prompt([], "en")
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _user_text(conversation), "Transcribe the English audio into text."
+        )
+        # Audio first, then the instruction; no system turn.
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [part["type"] for part in conversation[0]["content"]], ["audio", "text"]
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _user_text(self._prompt("", "zh")), "请将这段中文语音转换为纯文本。"
+        )
+        self.assertEqual(
+            _user_text(self._prompt("", None)), "Transcribe the audio into text."
+        )
+
+    def test_caller_text_is_kept(self):
+        self.assertEqual(self._prompt("Describe the clip.", "en"), "Describe the clip.")
+        # Chat requests may arrive as token ids; load_mm_data handles those.
+        self.assertEqual(self._prompt([151644, 872], None), [151644, 872])
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
